project.title: PortProof — Verified SQL Migration to Db2
project.short_description: Translates PostgreSQL and MySQL SQL to Db2 and makes Db2 itself prove the result: first that it compiles (server-side PREPARE), then that it returns the same answers (differential execution over six adversarial datasets). IBM's own translator raised no error on 32 statements; Db2 rejected 13 of them, and 2 more compiled while silently changing the answer.

members.name: Vishnu
members.role: Solo — Db2 schema and SQL PL, compile oracle, differential prover, LangGraph repair loop, Streamlit UI, test suite

features_used: PREPARE as a compile oracle (DeferredPrepare=0, server-side SQLCODE)
VECTOR(384, FLOAT32) columns and VECTOR_DISTANCE(..., COSINE)
Hybrid vector + relational recall in a single statement
SQL PL stored procedures with cursor and CONTINUE HANDLER
HASH(..., 2) SHA-256 certificates computed inside the engine
System-versioned temporal tables and FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF
MQT with REFRESH IMMEDIATE MAINTAINED BY SYSTEM
CHECK constraints, UNIQUE constraints, FOREIGN KEY ON DELETE CASCADE
WLM service class, workload and SQLROWSRETURNED / ESTIMATEDSQLCOST thresholds
Two-identity least-privilege split enforced by GRANT

ai_models: Deterministic rule engine (default, no API key)
